generalisation.note: Daodejing 42: 道→point→一→二→三 (real rectangles) →☰→八卦 (Fu Xi ring)→64 hexagrams→taiji→back to 道

visual.notes: Dense frames checked: 道 contracts to a point that draws out the real 一; 一 splits into 二, a bar is born between for 三 (all exact rectangles from Noto); 三 evens into ☰, rises to the top of a ring as the camera pulls back, the seven other trigrams fan out of it in Fu Xi order with their lines breaking into yin; each trigram spreads into eight hexagrams (a second trigram grows outward) — the 64 ring; the taiji grows inside; taiji and ring counter-rotate; everything returns to a point and 道 returns. No pops; vanish flags are the intended collapses (道 → point, ☰ shrinking in the pull-back, the final return). 0.2 ms median/frame.
